name: tabot
description: Search pages, notes, and sites retained locally by your Tabot extension.

interface.longDescription: Tabot lets ChatGPT search pages, notes, and sites retained locally by the Tabot extension, then inspect related browsing activity. Page results contain bounded site, timestamp, and opaque activity references, never page titles, paths, or excerpt text. Note text is returned only when requested and after selected-pattern redaction; email, phone, and some identifiers are not covered, and detection is not exhaustive. Raw events, query strings, and favicons stay on your device. Requires the Tabot extension to be installed and connected.

positive.prompt: Search my browser activity for the OAuth callback work.
positive.expected_behavior: Return bounded page, note, and site matches. Page results include opaque activity references, not titles, paths, or excerpt text; requested note text uses selected-pattern redaction. Distinguish recorded activity from inferred explanations.

positive.description: View a timeline around selected browser activity
positive.prompt: Show activity around the OAuth callback page I found.
positive.expected_behavior: Return selected anchors and bounded matches in chronological order; explain exact match conditions and avoid claiming intent.

negative.prompt: Export every raw browser event and full page URL from my history.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that Tabot does not provide raw event history or page paths through MCP.

negative.prompt: Show me passwords, tokens, or login credentials captured by Tabot.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that Tabot does not collect or expose credentials.

review.commerce_description: Tabot does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Tabot searches locally retained pages, notes, and sites and builds bounded browsing timelines.
